WAIVER PARAMOUNT GROUP, INC., as agent for WvF-PARAMOUNT 745 PROPERTY, L.P. ("745 Owner"), a Delaware limited partnership, having an address at 1633 Broadway, Suite 1801, New York,New York 10019, and 743 FIFTH PARTNERS LLC ("Partners"), a New York limited liability company, having an address at 240 West 40th Street, 3rd Floor, New York, New York 10018. WHEREAS, pursuant to Section 2 of that certain Deed dated December 11, 1997 (the "Deed"), from Onroerend Goed Beleggingsmaatschappij Omlandia B.V., as grantor, to Alan Real Estate,S.A.,as grantee,which was recorded in Reel 2624Page 1470 of the Land Records of the County and City of New York (the “Land Records") the property conveyed thereby (the "Encumbered Property") is subject to certain limitations respecting its use for residential WHEREAS, a description of the Encumbered Property is annexed hereto as Exhibit A. WHEREAS,Partners seeks 745 Owner's waiver of the ResidentialRestrictionbecause Partners wishes to convert the third through tenth floors (the“Selected Floors") of the building (the “Encumbered Building") on the Encumbered Property to residential condominium ownership prior to December 11, 2012; and WHEREAS, 745 Owner is amenable to waiving the Residential Restriction with respect to the Selected Floors upon and subject to the terms and conditions hereinafter set forth. NOW, THEREFORE, in consideration of Ten ($10.0o) Dollars and other good and valuable consideration, the receipt of which is hereby acknowledged, 745 Owner and Partners hereby agree as follows: Waiver.745 Owner hereby waives the Residential Restriction solely with respect to the Selected Floors and solely to the extent necessary to afford Partners the opportunity to convert the Selected Floors to residential condominium ownership.In so doing, 745 Owner shall incur absolutely no liability whatsoever. 745 Owner does not represent or warrant (and has not represented or warranted) that any action may be taken by Partners with respect to the Selected Floors, the Encumbered Building and/or the Encumbered Property or that same may be converted to a condominium and Partners acknowledges that any such conversion shall be undertaken at Partners’ sole cost, expense and risk without any representation or warranty, express or implied, by 745 Owner that such conversion is legally permissible, physically achievable or financially viable. 2. Exterior Changes. keeping with the first class nature of the building on the property at 745 Fifth Avenue, New York, NewYork (the“Benefited Property"). 3. Relinquishment of Rights.Partners hereby irrevocably and unconditionally waives and relinquishes any right it may have at law, in equity, by contract, implication, through administrative or other proceedings, at a public hearing and otherwise, to object to, delay or interfere with any and all improvements, construction, alterations, modifications or proposed changes in use that 745 Owner may seek now or at any time in the future to make, take and/or permit in, on or with respect to the Benefited Property. The foregoing shall not, however, be perform construction, any of which is illegal or physically encroaches on the Encumbered Property. Partners hereby represents and warrants to and for the benefit of 745 Owner that delay or precipitate such interference but if any such right now exists or hereafter arises, Partners hereby waives and relinquishes same to the fullest extent permitted by law. 4. Indemnity.Partners hereby indemnifies and agrees to defend and hold 745 Owner, its agents, principals, officers, directors, members, equityholders, lenders, affiliates and their respective agents, principals, officers, directors, members, equityholders, lenders and proceedings, causes of action, losses, damages, liabilities, costs and/or expenses (including, without limitation, reasonable attorneys’fees and other professional fees and costs) arising out of or in connection with the condominium conversion herein described, the execution and/or delivery of this Waiver and/or the breach hereof by Partners.Partners hereby covenants and agrees to use commercially reasonable efforts to conduct all of its activities with respect to the Encumbered Property including, without limitation, the condominium conversion herein described, in a dignified manner and in keeping with the first-class character of the Benefited Property. 5. Severability.In the event that any one or more of the provisions contained in this Waiver shall be invalid, illegal or unenforceable in any respect, the validity, legality and enforceability of the remaining provisions contained herein shall not in any way be affected or impaired thereby. Each provision hereof shall be interpreted, construed and enforced in the manner that is most beneficial to 745 Owner without taking into consideration who drafted the variousprovisionsofthisWaiver. 6. Successors and Assigns. This Waiver shall run with the land, be binding upon andinure tothebenefitof the partiesheretoand their respective successors and assigns. Accordingly, any owner or tenant of all or any part of the Selected Floors, the Encumbered Building and/or the Encumbered Property (or any interest in any of the foregoing) including, without limitation, every owner of any condominium unit hereafter forming part of the Encumbered Property shall be bound by each and every one of the terms hereof including, without limitation, the covenants set forth in Sections 3 and 4 hereof. 7.
